scenario.s1: The Cellar of the Plump Goose
scenario.s1.intro: Mistress Marta sighs: "Someone in the Plump Goose is carrying off everything that shines. Go down to the cellar and put things right. Mind the barrels!"
scenario.s1.outro: Among the stolen spoons and bowls lay a shard of the Lantern, dim but warm. Mistress Marta wraps it carefully in a cloth: "This is only the beginning."
scenario.s2.goal: All living heroes must reach the exit hexes by the forester's lodge
scenario.s2.intro: Mistress Marta unrolls a map: "The forester saw a light in the old lodge. The path there is overgrown with thorns, and the wolves have gone quite wild this autumn. Make your way to the hut and see who is lighting it."
scenario.s2.outro: By the lodge there was only the ash of a campfire and the prints of bandit boots. The tracks lead down to the old mill on the river.
scenario.s3.intro: The river has burst its banks and the mill stands knee-deep in water. Bandits guard the yard, and inside something big and wet is muttering. They say there is a lever in the sluice that drains the water.
scenario.s3.outro: The slime slides off the Miller and he is himself again: a tired old man who barely remembers the last few weeks. "Shadowhand," he whispers. "Tall, in a cloak of shadow. He took the light up to the old tower."
scenario.s4.goal: Take the Lantern piece from the upper tier and bring it back to the entrance
scenario.s4.intro: Lights burn again on the tower above the pass, but their glow is cold. The Gloom cultists have hidden the second piece of the Lantern there. The door to the upper tier is locked, and one of them carries the key.
scenario.s4.outro: The second piece of the Lantern is warm as bread from the oven. Among the cultists' papers lies a key of black glass: the key to the Heart of Gloom.
scenario.s5.intro: Beneath the Grey Mountains, behind a door of black glass, Shadowhand keeps the stolen light. Cold braziers stand along the walls. Light them, and the shadow will have nowhere to hide.
scenario.s5.outro: The glass orb on Shadowhand's chest cracks and the light comes home. Above Alba the Guardian Lantern shines again. Mistress Marta pours everyone hot tea: "Well, Braves, get some rest. Tomorrow brings new work."
scenarioSpecial.millSluice: A hero next to the sluice lever may spend a top action to lower the sluice: the water in the hall gets shallow and the Miller's "Flood" no longer works

scenarioSpecial.braziers: A hero next to a cold brazier may spend a bottom action to light it. While fewer than 3 braziers burn, Shadowhand takes half damage. A wraith that ends its turn next to a brazier puts it out

scenarioSpecial.windGusts: Wind gusts: at the end of every even round, all figures on the ledge are pushed 1 hex the way the pennants flap. Rams are not moved

scenario.s6.goal: Get every hero onto the lift by the end of round 11
scenario.s6.intro: The miners of Copperdale went into the mine three days ago and never came back. The tunnel is the shortest way, but the ceiling is old: where it cracks, rocks will soon fall. Run for the lift.
scenario.s6.outro: The gallery collapsed behind you, and in the chest lay Theo's helmet with one word on it: "Forge". A path leads down to Copperdale.
scenario.s7.goal: Lead the shepherd to the outpost gate
scenario.s7.intro: The long path over the pass leads to Copperdale. A shepherd is heading there too, and on the ledge the wind knocks even goats off their feet. Stay near the shepherd: he won't go on without you.
scenario.s7.outro: The shepherd arrived safe and gave you a sack of warm wool. From the outpost you can see Copperdale and the cultists' purple lanterns.
scenario.s8.goal: Break open all 3 cages of miners
scenario.s8.intro: Cultists and bandits have locked the miners in cages. Theo must be in the office, and a cultist in the south storeroom carries its key.
scenario.s8.outro: The miners are free, and Theo hugs Lina. He told you about the Old Forge and Hammerfist and left his lantern at the entrance to the depths.
scenario.s9.goal: Carry the miner's lamp to the seal on the gate
scenario.s9.intro: Under the mountains it's dark as a sack. Carry Theo's lantern to the forge gate: whoever falls will drop it. The moths fly to the light.
scenario.s9.outro: The seal blazed up, and the gate swung open. From inside come the boom of a hammer and the giant's sleepy voice.
scenario.s10.intro: Hammerfist, the old smith giant, forges the Dark Lantern by night. While the Lantern on the anvil is whole, the giant is almost impossible to hurt, and the furnaces call the moths. Wake him up.
scenario.s10.outro: The Dark Lantern shattered, the moths turned white, and the giant woke up and said sorry for the noise. Only one black moth flew off to the north.
